education.institution: G.B Pant DSEU Okhla Campus III

details: Conducted Web and Android Application Security Testing using SAST and DAST methodologies across 100+ internal applications

Performed Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) aligned with OWASP Top 10, identifying 150+ vulnerabilities including SQL Injection, XSS, SSRF, IDOR, File Upload, JWT flaws, and Access Control issues
Executed Nessus-based infrastructure vulnerability scans across enterprise networks, supporting remediation and re-validation
Performed manual security testing for authentication, authorization, session management, and business logic vulnerabilities
Analyzed Android applications using ADB, MobSF, Burp Suite, and Frida to detect runtime misconfigurations, insecure storage, and sensitive data exposure
Assisted in OT Security proof-of-concept evaluations, strengthening organizational cyber resilience
Collaborated with development and infrastructure teams to validate fixes, reducing critical vulnerabilities by an estimated 50% post-remediation
Prepared detailed VAPT reports including risk assessment, CVSS scoring, PoCs, and remediation recommendations

projects.name: Application Security Simulator – Secure Coding Training Platform
details: Designed and developed an interactive application security training platform featuring live vulnerability simulations
Implemented vulnerable vs secure ASP.NET Core code examples to demonstrate real-world exploitation and mitigation
Covered OWASP Top vulnerabilities including SQL Injection, XSS, SSRF, JWT Weak Keys, File Upload, SSTI, LFI, Access Control, and CSV Injection
Built HTTP request/response visualization to help developers understand attack flow and security impact
Deployed a live web application with downloadable SOP documentation, improving developer security awareness
